The cut is untouched: piles.json stays byte-identical and this game stays in the sealed pile. A contaminated sealed game is annotated, not moved into the development pile (INC-BA-001 recommendation 2). Ruled F-11 (monitor acting for the owner, 2026-07-28), the conservative merge of the two proposals on the table.

rule: A held-out claim may name only games in `claim_set`. Games in `retained_with_sensitivity_analysis` are in the claim set but their exposure is disclosed, so any statistic over the claim set must be reported a second time with them excluded; if the two disagree, the weaker one governs. Games in `needs_adjudication` are in neither `clean` nor any settled bucket and must be ruled on before they carry any claim.
